implementation: Shared conversation service with native Swift and Kotlin window bindings; account-owned queries and independent pagination/observation
limitations: Real backend is isolated local PostgreSQL/HTTPS/TLS, not production.
iOS and Android acceptance used simulators/emulator, not physical devices or signed distribution.
Existing iOS page presentation and Android default foreground snapshot compatibility remain; independent window handles are available without adding desktop multiwindow UI.
Domain projection types and low-level composition entry points remain for compatibility; public API narrowing is a subsequent migration.
Other feature services have not all moved to the new facade. Windows implementation and native validation remain incomplete.
Broad iOS accessibility audit was not rerun; its earlier Dynamic Type limitation is not declared fixed.
